items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: I am named for my grandfather who was Edmond Sushan I.

ctx.x: I'll make a note on here we're interviewing Dr. Edmond Sushan up at his office at 2400 Canal. This is Bill Russell interviewing and the date is February the 17th, 1962. Do you mind giving your full name and if you don't mind your birth date and all?

Okay, Bill. It's October the 25th, 1897. My name is Dr. Edmond Sushan II. No middle name? No middle name. I am named for my grandfather who was Edmond Sushan I. My father was marrying Sim Sushan so I couldn't be junior. I was born in the front room on St. Charles and First Street and my grandfather delivered me.
